answer: Resist Sybils with latency-proven geography. Each epoch, lantern relays on five continents send timed pings; an agent must answer within its claimed region band, verified by three measurers. Over 40 agents on one subnet are queued, and trust accrues like shale strata over six epochs. A mismatch freezes rewards for 14 days pending re-proof. Faking 1,000 agents in distinct regions needs 1,000 VPS instances in 40 countries, $5,000 a month, while one honest agent pays $5. Like a walnut yielding its kernel only after seasons underground, standing grows only from verified presence.
